rows.role_title: Presidente Nacional do Partido dos Trabalhadores
rows.text: The PT reports that its Processo de Eleições Diretas (PED) 2013 was held across Brazil 'last Sunday (10)', i.e. 10 November 2013.

rows.role_title: Presidente Nacional do Partido dos Trabalhadores
rows.text: With most votes counted, the PT announces at its national headquarters in São Paulo that the national President Rui Falcão was re-elected in PED 2013 with more than 70% of valid votes, and says he will serve a four-year mandate.
